completion_scope: A completed contrast can be reported even if a different noncompared version remains pending; the whole four-version experiment stays incomplete. An empty population cannot establish a completed experiment.
family_policy: Retain supplied family identifiers and sizes for later resampling. This component adopts no family proposals, merges no profiles, establishes no case independence, and inspects no protected family records.
independent_outcomes: The compact outcome schema accepts externally established disposition/success/completeness. It does not parse responses, implement rule checks, select a designated response, verify provenance or establish that a claimed external score is correct. The later score-ledger adapter must bind run, profile, family, frozen version, designated response hash and independent scorer version before comparison.

independent_scoring_policy.designated_response: Freeze each workflow's designated returned response rule before final runs. Independently score that saved response before user edits; bind its hash. Do not silently substitute an earlier diagnostic draft or choose the strongest of multiple completed generations.
independent_scoring_policy.optional_source_ids: Optional source-ID fields stay optional formatting. Missing attribution can affect evidence findings without introducing an unplanned format requirement.
independent_scoring_policy.post_result_changes: Preserve failed outcomes. Changes prompted by final results require a documented new experiment, not a silent amendment of the current comparison.
independent_scoring_policy.revision_cap: If the frozen Version 4 workflow specifies return of its last checked candidate at the revision cap, independently score that designated candidate under the same rules. A fatal workflow error remains an execution failure; do not fall back to a diagnostic draft.
independent_scoring_policy.shared_conditions: Use the same public profile inputs, shared input/output/parsing contracts, base model and common generation settings. Record retrieval, specialists, internal evaluation and revision as intended workflow differences.
independent_scoring_policy.version4_internal_flag: Version 4 internal acceptance is not the independent research result; it cannot set external success.

missing_policy: Missing rows, unstarted execution, unfinished assessment and not-ready outcomes remain unscored, not False. Do not drop incomplete pairs into a smaller complete-case denominator. Full rates/differences remain null for an unready population, incomplete contrasted outcomes or a zero denominator.
paired_outcomes: Retain every profile/family link. Count improved, worsened, unchanged success, unchanged non-success and incomplete pairs. Match by profile/version identifiers, not row position. Retain known partner outcomes when the other is pending.
point_estimate: Each profile has one equal weight. Success rate uses all declared feasible profiles per version. Pair differences are later minus earlier in percentage points: 100 * (improved - worsened) / profile_count. Families do not reweight the point estimate.

population.readiness: population_ready is a supplied prerequisite, not an acceptance validator. Before actual use, verify the complete accepted feasible population, adopted families, expectations, rules/references and scoring versions. A partial or unaccepted roster must not be marked ready.

step31_uncertainty_handoff.estimands: Recompute profile-level planner metrics and record-level classifier metrics on each resample. Do not replace them with unweighted averages of family/group scores.
step31_uncertainty_handoff.interpretation: Intervals describe sensitivity to the constructed benchmark cases, not real-athlete outcomes or training-seed variability.
step31_uncertainty_handoff.pairing: Keep matched model/version outcomes together within each sampled group and include every member of a drawn group with its multiplicity.
step31_uncertainty_handoff.status: planned; operational procedure and implementation pending Step 31

version_mapping: V1 through V4 are fixed analyst aliases for the four planned workflows. Bind them to frozen runner/workflow versions before real evaluation; this cell assigns no actual run IDs.
